scientific limitations/integrity: Exact only for the real two-dimensional mixed endpoint (p,q)=(infinity,1) of the max-of-two-lp family. The proof is analytic and finite; no numerical experiment is used as proof. The motivating 2022 source displays only the two same-side exponent regimes in Example 4.10, while targeted literature and semantic-index searches found no equivalent mixed-endpoint Heinz formula. Search noncoverage cannot prove absolute novelty.
title: Exact Heinz-mean profile of the cut-square absolute norm family
